instance.description: Predict lithium ionic conductivity for a single composition. Returns a binary classification (1 if conductivity > 1e-4 S/cm, 0 otherwise) and a regression value (predicted conductivity in log10 S/cm).

query.description: Normalized formula of the query composition

dataset.description: Batch prediction for multiple compositions. Accepts either an inline list of composition strings or a CSV file with a 'composition' column. Runs the same CrabNet classification + regression for each composition and writes all results to a single JSON asset.

compositions.description: Inline list of compositions to predict (alternative to file, for API-style batch queries)

file.description: CSV file with a 'composition' column (for large batches, up to ~2000 compositions)

result.json.description: JSON with classification and regression predictions for each composition
